name: motion-error-shake
title: Error Shake
description: Ô email lắc ngang mạnh rồi nhỏ dần, viền chuyển đỏ và dòng báo lỗi hiện ra.

moworks.author: takayu

options.amp: px of the first swing (36; 12 on the site's demo), then 10 / 6 / 4 in proportion
options.message: the error line (fades in sliding down)

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio error-shake, written here): After a click on 'Log in', the email field shakes x 0 → −12 → +10 → −6 → +4 → 0 px at 0 / 90 / 200 / 310 / 420 / 540 ms (sine.inOut between keys); within the first 120 ms its outline turns red and thickens 1.5 → 2.5 px and a '!' badge appears; the error message fades in, sliding 4 px down, 300–550 ms. Params: keys (−12 / 10 / −6 / 4 px) · duration (0.54 s) · color lỗi.
